_comment: Ledger: blocks, transactions, rules and state of every era (module ledger). Its reference is cardano-ledger. docs/design/correspondence-map.md says what an entry holds; scripts/check_correspondence.py checks it.

def ledger.byron.ByronLedger.applyTx.note: the outputs a transaction creates are keyed by the hash of its bytes as received; the reference's txId is serializeCborHash of the transaction encoded again. The rule's other checks are not mapped here: the counterpart named is where the difference is

glue.reason: the state layout of each reference build Scarab can follow, and the defect of a build whose layout is not implemented yet, which the node's setup refuses before any rule runs (#1002, stage 0); the reference is one build and has no counterpart
